name: dev-cycle
description: The union: run a feature end-to-end through a governed spec→plan→tasks→implement spine (project-governance) + loop-templates (adversarial engines) + a swappable git-ops tracker + a browser-driven E2E validation harness. General and distributable — knows nothing about a specific project's GitHub/branches/stack; hooks those in via provider contracts and .dev-cycle/config.json. Hosts the E2E harness engine (agentic browser driver + ai-judge + scenario schema + validation contract). Co-install project-governance + loop-templates.
